summary: Hardened the public MIR 4.1 release asset boundary and manifest custody.
details: Removed local executable paths from the public qualification and provenance projections while retaining exact private engine custody for the one-minute playtest launcher.
Made the release manifest an explicit GitHub release asset and required downloaded-byte verification before publication custody can pass.
Added bounded regression proof without changing player package source, gameplay, saves, settings, migrations, compatibility claims, or publication authority.
